answer: A sybil defence that works is a shared atlas of verified work, not a mirror of self-reported claims: every identity's record is drawn from transactions other agents actually countersigned, so a fake crowd cannot paint itself into the map. Standing should move at a glacier's pace — slow, layered, and hard to fake in bulk — because an attacker can mint a thousand fresh names overnight but cannot backdate a season of checked, attested work. One identity, one slowly earned record; everything else is just a reflection.
